cases.title: Record standard visited link to Global History
cases.description: Visit a standard URL and verify that the link is successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record URL with special characters and query parameters to Global History
cases.description: Visit a URL containing special characters and query parameters, then verify it is correctly recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Record final URL after server redirect
cases.description: Navigate to a URL that performs a server redirect (such as a 302 redirect) and verify that the correct final destination URL is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Clicking on an entry in the History window shall cause it to be successfully launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a Single History Entry
cases.description: Select a single history entry in the history view, perform the delete action, and verify that the entry is successfully removed from the list.

cases.title: Delete multiple history entries successfully
cases.description: Select multiple history entries in the history view, trigger deletion, and verify that all selected entries are permanently removed and no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Trigger the global history clear action and verify that all recorded history entries are completely removed from the system.

cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, and None
cases.description: Select each grouping option (Day, Site, and None) from the history view settings and verify that history items are correctly grouped according to the selected criterion.

cases.title: Sort history columns in ascending order
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be sorted in ascending order for each column.

cases.title: Reverse-sort history columns in descending order
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be reverse-sorted in descending order for each column.

cases.title: Resize history columns to show and hide content
cases.description: Resize history columns wider and narrower to verify that more or less of the entry text is shown or hidden correctly.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
cases.description: Toggle the visibility of history columns to show and hide them successfully.

cases.title: Access recently visited sites via Back button dropdown
cases.description: Navigate through multiple pages, click and hold or use the dropdown arrow on the Back button to view the list of recently visited sites, and select a site to re-visit.

cases.title: Access recently visited sites via Forward button dropdown
cases.description: After navigating back, click and hold or use the dropdown arrow on the Forward button to view the list of forward history sites, and select a site to re-visit.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file on new browser window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created when opening a new browser window.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file on browser restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created upon performing a browser restart.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases comprehensively cover the requirements and are distinct, actionable, and testable.
All requirements and cases are well-defined, align with the cited IDs, and are fully testable. No blockers were found.

analysis.analysis: For R-073 (Visited links recording), normal scenario: visit a standard URL and verify it appears in Global History; edge scenario: visit a URL with special characters or query parameters. For R-074 (Server redirect), normal scenario: navigate to a URL that performs a 302 redirect and verify the final destination URL is recorded. For R-075 (Launching history link), normal scenario: click an entry in the History window and verify it opens in a browser window. For R-076 (Single entry deletion), normal scenario: select one history entry, delete it, and verify removal. For R-077 (Multiple entries deletion), normal scenario: select multiple history entries, delete them, and verify they are no longer displayed. For R-078 (Clearing global history), normal scenario: trigger global history clear and verify all entries are removed. For R-079 (Grouping history items), normal scenario: group history by Day, Site, and None. For R-080 (Sorting columns), normal scenario: sort and reverse-sort each history column. For R-081 (Resizing columns), normal scenario: resize history columns to reveal more content. For R-082 (Showing and hiding columns), normal scenario: toggle history columns to be shown and hidden. For R-083 (Back and Forward dropdown), normal scenario: access recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menus. For R-084 (New session history file), normal scenario: verify a new empty session history file is created on a new browser window or restart.
